content.value:
. The room sensible heat gain and latent heat gain of a conditioned space are 40 kW and 15   
15 kW respectively. The inside design conditions are 25° DBT and 55% RH. The return   
air is mixed with outside air before entering the cooling coil in the ratio of 3:1 by weight.   
Assuming the bypass factor of the cooling coil is 0.13, determine:   
(i) Apparatus dew point (ADP)   
(ii) Ventilation air in cmm   
(iii) Total refrigeration load of the plant
